items.name: cauchy_product
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [Ring β] {abv : β → α} [IsAbsoluteValue abv] {f g : ℕ → β} (ha : IsCauSeq abs fun m => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, abv (f n)) (hb : IsCauSeq abv fun m => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, g n) (ε : α) (ε0 : 0 < ε) : ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, abv ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, f k) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, g k - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range j, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f m * g (n - m)) < ε
